note: The register of record is registry/sources.csv (licence, use, assessment). The rows here add what the doctrine kit needs for the sources that feed public products: Admiralty grade, independence group, how easily the data could be faked, expected cadence and a health probe.

adsblol-archive.descriptor: Crowd-fed ADS-B receiver archive (readsb traces with navigation-accuracy fields); daily file posted next morning.

noaa-swpc.descriptor: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center official indices and alerts.

esa-swe-scint.descriptor: ESA Space Weather Service Network ionospheric scintillation nowcast grid.

easa-gnss-firs.descriptor: EASA's table of FIRs with reported GNSS interference; official, updated irregularly.

navcen-gps-tests.descriptor: US Coast Guard Navigation Center notices of US GPS interference testing.

cygnss-l1.descriptor: NASA CYGNSS level-1 reflectometry; its noise floor is an independent sensing method for interference.

airframes.descriptor: Volunteer-fed aircraft datalink archive (ACARS, HFDL, SATCOM aero); its receivers are separate from ADS-B feeders, though some feeders run both.

satnogs-db.descriptor: Crowd-edited satellite and transmitter catalogue of the SatNOGS project.

satnogs-network.descriptor: Volunteer SatNOGS ground-station observations (waterfalls, frames); same project as satnogs-db.

batc-qo100-fft.descriptor: Wideband spectrum of the QO-100 amateur GEO transponder from one receiver at Goonhilly.

isoc-pulse.descriptor: Internet Society's curated shutdown records. Compiled from Google Transparency Report, IODA, Cloudflare Radar, OONI, Access Now and others: never a separate line beside those.

ooni.descriptor: OONI volunteer probe measurements of blocking by country and network.

google-traffic.descriptor: Google's normalised product traffic by country and its hand-kept disruption list.

traficom-gnss-stats.descriptor: Finnish Transport and Communications Agency interference statistics; aviation counts use its own monitoring and ADS-B.

lithuania-rrt.descriptor: Lithuanian communications regulator statements, mostly via news interviews.

pl-ilpib.descriptor: Polish National Institute of Telecommunications monitoring findings (with GUGiK on RTGMS.pl).

csno-tarc.descriptor: China Satellite Navigation Office test centre: BeiDou notices to users.

miit-rab.descriptor: China's MIIT Radio Administration Bureau notices.

srrc.descriptor: China's State Radio Monitoring Center case notices.

glonass-iac.descriptor: Roscosmos GLONASS information centre: constellation status and notices.

korea-crms.descriptor: Korea's Central Radio Management Service (MSIT) jamming figures.

icao-mid-papers.descriptor: ICAO MID meeting papers; each paper is its submitting state's claim, so count it under that state.

taiwan-mnd.descriptor: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense daily PLA activity counts.

windward.descriptor: Windward's commercial AIS analytics, published as marketing material.

ut-austin-rnl.descriptor: UT Austin Radionavigation Laboratory research papers.

leolabs-public.descriptor: LeoLabs public statements from its LEO radar network.

exoanalytic-public.descriptor: ExoAnalytic (Anduril from 2026) public statements from its GEO telescope network.
